title: C:autonomous-heredity: pcell-mwall, walled particle-catalyst cells from noise with a self-made wall-material layer (M rim/core 3.0), whose heritable link efficiency is selected by intrinsic whole-cell deaths on 4/4 seeds
summary: c06's pcell-yeff-cap (heritable, capped link efficiency carried by ~10^4 identity-carrying Brownian catalyst particles inside Allen-Cahn cells, identical-event inert marker z) plus one new species M: wall material made by the catalyst from substrate (bm K S), moved by phi^2-gated diffusion and adsorption up the wall indicator (chim 4), decaying slowly (dm 0.002), with no feedback on phi, links or particles. From noise, labkit gives an M layer at the wall on 2/2 seeds (rim/core 3.0 and 2.96, rim/out 3.85 and 5.67, 88/102 and 102/118 individuals membrane-like) and 11 and 9 persistent splits (generation 3 and 2, merge/split 0.11 and 0.22); mfig_s*.png shows the M ring around every cell, through divisions. With no imposed deaths, on 4/4 seeds (exact particle-identity genealogy, the same deterministic trajectories) mean yield rises 1.00 -> 1.16-1.18 while the marker ends at 0.95-1.02; mature-cell deaths sit at the 1st-6th yield percentile (marker 39th-54th); dying cells were already low at birth (rank 0.20-0.32, marker 0.40-0.63) and lose only 0.04-0.10 yield during life; low-born cells die more often than high-born ones on 4/4 seeds (0.60/0.41, 0.73/0.38, 0.53/0.17, 0.81/0.27).

claims.statement: In pcell-mwall from an unstructured start (noisy phi, uniform random particle soup, M = 0; pack/seed*/sheet.png t=0), 15-27 discrete cells form, each enclosed by a layer of the self-made wall material M that differs from both interior and exterior (labkit radial M rim/core 3.0/2.96, rim/out 3.85/5.67 on seeds 0/1; mfig_s0.png), and they divide (labkit 11 and 9 persistent splits, max generation 3 and 2; genealogy 13-16 persistent splits per run, generation 3-4, 0-2 merges, 4 seeds). A heritable link efficiency that arises by mutation (0.002 per particle duplication) is selected by intrinsic whole-cell deaths only: mature-cell deaths at the 1st-6th yield percentile against the 39th-54th for an identical-event inert marker on the same particles, low-born cells die more often than high-born ones on 4/4 seeds, and the population mean rises to 1.16-1.18 against 0.95-1.02 for the marker.
claims.track: seed 0, labkit track 57 (pack/seed0/lineage.png, tracks.png row 4): generation 3 (31 -> 49 -> 53 -> 57 via persistent splits at t~63500, 75500 and 84500), walled by its M layer (mfig_s0.png rows 2-3) and alive to t=100000 while low-yield cells die around it

controls_run.H: identical-event inert marker z in the same four runs (selfig.png, data/summary.txt: death percentile 0.39-0.54, birth rank of dying cells 0.40-0.63, mean 0.95-1.02)
controls_run.B: the M source ablation bm=0 is the parent pcell-yeff-cap (packs of 20261025T1108-c06-pcell-efficiency-claim): no M; its L link layer is rim/core 1.32-1.33, below the gate

claims.limits: M is a passive layer: it has no feedback on phi, the links or the particles, so it does no work (the wall's mechanics and particle containment are those of the parent: phi tilt and phi^2 gate); attempts to make M the particle gate (data/screen_mwall.txt, gate 0 or soft gate with an M Metropolis gate) killed every cell from noise. B is therefore a self-made quasi-equilibrium layer in the rubric's sense, not a working membrane. The M layer is 2-4 px wide at 128^2 with no resolution test. Kinds are ranks of a continuous trait. The H statistics come from genealogy.py runs that replay the same seeds deterministically (final cell counts 17/16 match labkit's 17/16 on seeds 0/1); labkit packs exist for seeds 0 and 1 only. The gen-3 split crops in mfig are centred approximately (component-overlap locator). Splits are not selected (mean percentile 0.52-0.63).
